title: Minimal normative subset for foreign implementations (Wave 11-A)
note: A second implementation claiming draft conformance MUST cover every rule and fixture below. Expanding the set — or moving a fixture's expected disposition — is a draft bump recorded in changeLog, never a silent widen.

changeLog.change: Frozen (Wave 11-A): 14 normative rule ids + 11 fixtures covering CARRIED / LOWERED / REFUSED / UNSUPPORTED.
grid-2d: REFUSED -> CARRIED. The declared widen the frozen entry was staged for — a foreign implementation must now CARRY an auto-placed declared-track grid, not refuse it by name.
changeLog.why: The REFUSED row was recorded against a Figma that had no grid layout mode. The A1 recon probed the platform half live (docs/research/grid-recon-probes.md: P1 layoutMode 'GRID' exists and reads back; P8 a 3x4 bento's tracks, gaps, anchors and spans all read back EXACTLY; P5/P5b ROW_AUTO_FLOW is the one bounded auto flow; P9 the implicit-track readback is lossy and fences the derivation). The G5 engine round (2026-08-08) then taught extract/computed promoteGridLayout placement-from-order: an all-auto grid's cells are derived from child order exactly as CSS row flow resolves them and DECLARED — as explicit Part.placement anchors when the author declared row tracks, as layout.flow 'row' with rows omitted when they did not — with occupancy past the declared track rectangle refused by name (grid-implicit-tracks, P9).
changeLog.evidence: conformance/BASELINE.json: grid-2d PASS as CARRIED (was PASS as REFUSED/grid-two-dimensional), and grid-two-column, grid-sidebar-px-fr, grid-track-fit-content, grid-tracks-mixed-fractional, grid-auto-flow-row all WRONG-NAME -> PASS in the same round. REFUSED remains demonstrable in the subset through display-out-of-vocab and svg-outside-grammar (N-DISP-01 needs one fixture per disposition).

normativeRules.text: Every component contract MUST have a stable id that is never reused for a different component.
Identity MUST follow id (and per-surface anchors after first sync); display name MAY change.
version MUST be semver and MUST bump when a contract change is published.
For every fact in the declared support grammar, conversion MUST return exactly one of CARRIED, LOWERED, REFUSED, UNSUPPORTED.
Silent loss, silent invention, silent fallback, and silent overwrite are MUST NOT.
Removing/renaming a prop or value, or narrowing accepted slot content, MUST be a major change.
Existing fields MUST NOT be repurposed to mean something else without a major bump and migration note.
A surface binding MUST NOT invent a canonical value absent from the contract prop enum/type.
Generated artifacts MUST be deterministic for the same supported inputs where the implementation claims determinism.
Styling decisions MUST live on named anatomy parts, not as unexplained literals on a single surface.
Nested component instances MUST preserve contract identity or be REFUSED by name.
Tools that mutate contracts, source, or canvas MUST require an explicit confirmation step before write (or document an equivalent review gate).
Suggested write-backs MUST be propose-only unless the operator explicitly applies them.
An implementation claiming conformance MUST pass this subset kit (or publish a mapped equivalent with equal coverage) and disclose unsupported grammar rows rather than skipping them as green.
